scope: Public SizedBox/ConstrainedBox/LimitedBox/OverflowBox/UnconstrainedBox/LayoutBuilder/IntrinsicWidth/IntrinsicHeight/SizedOverflowBox/ConstraintsTransformBox/PreferredSize options and their retained consumers in incular-widgets. Several are composition shorthands that lower to other retained kinds; the lowering target is recorded per option. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.

records.validation: finite widths clamp to a tight lower-bound of zero at conversion; infinite defers to expand

comparison.prose: Finite dimensions compose into a ConstrainedBox whose additional constraints clamp into the parent via enforced_constraints.

records.validation: finite heights clamp to a tight lower-bound of zero at conversion

comparison.prose: Shares the width conversion path on the vertical axis.

comparison.prose: Child edges reconcile through the generic element update after composition.

records.validation: stored raw, no floor; a negative minimum fails deferred at Constraints::new in the Overflow arm

comparison.prose: The Overflow arm composes child constraints from the supplied bounds and the incoming minimums, so minimums force growth while the reported size stays parent-constrained. Raw min values flow unvalidated to Constraints::new, an established asymmetry with LimitedBox's floors.
